notes: GAAP city, FY ending 9/30/2025. Attempt 3 (verifier fixes 2026-10-28): business-type 'Customer accounting and collections' 7,082,136 (p6) set to category utilities (it is a functional line like Production, Distribution, Administrative and general; the earlier cost-type category had been left in place); nonmajor combining 'Intergovernmental' 5,826,299 (p12) now federal grants because the American Rescue Plan column 3,132,206 is more than half of it (review names the mix). Re-check (attempt 2): governmental 'Intergovernmental' marked review for its ARPA (federal) part (26% of the statement line, so state/local aid stays dominant). No other targeted pattern applies (no homestead/credit/pro-rate lines, investment income lines are labelled investment income, debt service already split, cost of power/gas is Purchased Power/Cost of Sales; GAAP report keeps the Statement of Net Position). Governmental receipts/disbursements from the governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures (p4, Total Governmental Funds column); balances reconcile (64,936,067 - 8,204,080 + 3,601,759 = 60,333,746). Other financing: loan proceeds 63,739 -> debt_proceeds; insurance recoveries 51,769 -> other_financing. ending_cash = cash and cash equivalents on governmental funds balance sheet (p3); County treasurer cash 288,736 and investments 18,826,145 are separate lines, not included in ending_cash; investments recorded in ending_investments for information. Business-type from proprietary funds statement (p6, Total enterprise column, Electric/Water/Sewer/Gas; Internal Service excluded). Business net position rolls: 233,000,327 + (receipts 100,015,941 - disbursements 84,801,758 = 15,214,183) + other financing 285,145 (contributed capital 422,175 less cost recovered 137,030) - transfers net 3,486,251 - restatement 1,534,815 = 243,478,589. Gain(loss) on sale of assets (315,871) recorded as negative receipt. No single printed total for business-type receipts/disbursements; computed from operating plus nonoperating lines. Proprietary cash flows from p7 total column (Enterprise funds). Transfers cross-check: governmental in 11,483,611 and out 7,997,360 (net +3,486,251) equals business-type net transfers out (1,203,674 in less 4,689,925 out = -3,486,251); no transfers are hidden inside spending lines. Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p9), Street (p10), Sales Tax (p11) and nonmajor combining (p12). The p12 combining page shows only six nonmajor fund columns plus the Total Non-Major column; the other nonmajor funds are on a page not trimmed, so detail records the Total Non-Major Governmental Funds column (fund 'Nonmajor funds (combined)'). Budget-schedule General Fund actuals (budgetary basis) differ from the GAAP statement; both recorded as printed. No business-type (utility) budget schedules are in the trimmed PDF. Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position, Total column (p1).
